name: kind
description: What sort of thing a problem is.

aiGuidance.purpose: Classifies a problem as belief, capability, condition, consequence or shift. Aligned with muSrs argument/kind.
aiGuidance.extraction: Pick the one term that best matches the statement; a consequence follows from other problems, a shift is a change in the world.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Do not invent values; the domain is closed.
